identity.transitionTitle: THE IDEA GIVING WAY TO THE WORK
identity.transitionText: What started as code and creativity now takes shape in real projects. Every line written, every design decision, every problem solved. Inspiration doesn't come from nowhere — it's built, line by line, project by project.

about.quote: Technology is a means, not an end — my focus is solving real business problems through good user experience.
about.body1: With over 8 years developing web and mobile products using React, React Native, and TypeScript, I've worked across retail (Magalu), tourism, fintech (EqSeed, Finnet), and international e-commerce (Samsung Latin America, via Trinto | Digital Partners).
about.body2: I also dedicate part of my career to technical mentorship, taking as much pride in helping other developers grow as in the code itself.
